purpose: Actionable, case-ID-bound intake for exact 35 open named CTR source questions. No numeric assignments or compliance approvals.
receipt_policy: Document checkbox means received for review, not legally verified. A checkmark, date, note or reference never changes ledger, activates contaminant limit, or grants PASS.
data_handling: Receipt notes are stored only in this browser localStorage; no upload, no WordPress write, no account sync.
